title: Real terminal review startup and child monitoring
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUN_ID to a live local static review. Optional FARMSLOT_REVIEW_EXPECT_BINARY, FARMSLOT_REVIEW_EXPECT_CHILD_STEPS and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_FAILED_RUN_ID pin the machine executable, checklist size and a historical failed-start attempt. Startup must have runner-native exact-prompt acceptance or a real task signal; this recipe creates no task signals.

live-startup.intent: Read the production run and child progress through gateway RPC, verify startup independently of the first model-written mark using native prompt acceptance when available, and reject an unacknowledged worker.
